trap.label: say × tell
trap.wrong: Ms. Park said me to sit down.
trap.right: Ms. Park told me to sit down.
trap.why: Em português “disse a mim” usa dizer com objeto indireto. Em inglês say não aceita a pessoa diretamente; com pessoa usa-se tell (told me).

mcq.q: She ___ me that I was late.

mcq.why: A vírgula fica dentro das aspas.

fix.wrong: He asked me what was my name.
fix.right: He asked me what my name was.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com told: “She said to me that she was happy.”
rewrite.answer: She told me that she was happy.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “She smiles and says thanks.”
Troque Then por After that: “First he read. Then he wrote.”
rewrite.answer: First he read. After that he wrote.
